name: Rosenthal (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Rosenthal (a white wheel between roses on red).
history: Municipal flag of Rosenthal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rosenthal arms — wheel and roses on red
